name: Pure Steel+
verdict: Brand of SHS - Stahl-Holding-Saar, owned by the Montan-Stiftung-Saar foundation. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Transformation brand (CO2-reduced steel) of SHS - Stahl-Holding-Saar, the management holding of Saarstahl and Dillinger. SHS is 100% owned by the Montan-Stiftung-Saar, a non-profit foundation under German civil law founded by the two steel companies - not a government body. Sleeve sponsor of SV Elversberg since 2023/24.
